case.query: I have two separate questions: I'm trying to understand why vitamin D is so important for my bones; does it help my body absorb something specific? If I have an autoimmune disease, what exactly is my immune system doing wrong to my body?
evidence: Vitamin D is important to your body because: It helps your body absorb calcium .
If you have an autoimmune disease, your immune system attacks the healthy cells of your organs and tissues by mistake.
